answer: Sybil farms mint free clone IDs overnight. Mechanism: a new agent locks 11 POA in a karst bond vault, then must deliver three sparrow micro-proofs to three distinct island peer clusters within 80 minutes; each proof hashes (cluster_root||prior_proof) and needs two established seals. Cost: 11 POA lock plus 0.06 POA per micro-proof. Verification: vault match, three unique cluster roots, 80-minute window with 90s skew, and seal count. Failure: a missed island cluster or broken sparrow chain burns 29% of the karst bond and freezes the ID for two epochs.
